title.uk: Сталі фрази з прийменниками на роботі 2

focus.en: More fixed phrases: in addition to, in my opinion, in advance, on the whole, out of date, in a hurry, on the way, at the end of the day, on the understanding that, on request.
focus.uk: Ще сталі фрази: in addition to, in my opinion, in advance, on the whole, out of date, in a hurry, on the way, at the end of the day, on the understanding that, on request.

exercises.text: ___ addition to the salary, the job includes a pension plan.
exercises.uk: Окрім зарплати, робота передбачає пенсійний план.

why.en: In addition to = as well as.
why.uk: In addition to = окрім, на додачу до.

exercises.text: ___ my opinion, we should hire an external auditor.
exercises.uk: На мою думку, нам варто найняти зовнішнього аудитора.

why.en: In my opinion, not on or by.
why.uk: In my opinion, а не on чи by.

exercises.uk: Будь ласка, бронюйте залу для нарад заздалегідь.

exercises.text: There were a few problems, but ___ the whole it was a good year.
exercises.uk: Було кілька проблем, але загалом рік був вдалий.

exercises.text: This software is ___ date; please install the update.
exercises.uk: Ця програма застаріла; будь ласка, встановіть оновлення.

why.en: Out of date = old, not current; up to date = current.
why.uk: Out of date = застарілий; up to date = актуальний.

exercises.text: Sorry, I'm ___ a hurry — can we talk later?
exercises.uk: Вибачте, я поспішаю — можемо поговорити пізніше?

exercises.text: The documents are ___ the way; they should arrive tomorrow.
exercises.uk: Документи вже в дорозі; мають прибути завтра.

why.en: On the way = travelling towards you; in the way = blocking.
why.uk: On the way = в дорозі; in the way = заважає, на заваді.

exercises.text: ___ the end of the day, it's the client's decision.

why.en: At the end of the day = when everything is considered (informal).
why.uk: At the end of the day = зрештою, коли все зважено (розмовне).

exercises.text: I signed ___ the understanding that the price was fixed.
exercises.uk: Я підписав, розуміючи, що ціна фіксована.

why.en: On the understanding that = on the condition that.
why.uk: On the understanding that = за умови, що.

why.en: On (or upon) request = if you ask.
